description: This file defines the culture information for Spanish (Argentina) for the DateJS library, including date formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and various date manipulation functions specific to the 'es-AR' culture.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of the date object to zero, effectively clearing the time part.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Updates the date object to the current system time.
